title: ESG and BRSR Report Data Extraction
summary: Extract BRSR and sustainability report indicators into a cited, unit-normalised dataset, compare years and flag gaps, inconsistencies and assurance status for ESG analysts.

seo.title: ESG and BRSR Report Data Extraction with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that extracts BRSR and sustainability indicators, normalises units, compares years and flags disclosure gaps and inconsistencies for ESG analysts.

problem.intro: SEBI requires the largest listed companies to publish a Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report, and investors, lenders and rating teams want that data in a usable form. The indicators are there, across nine principles and a set of BRSR Core KPIs, but they arrive in different layouts, units and levels of completeness, alongside annual reports and standalone sustainability reports.

pain_points.title: Indicators scattered across documents
pain_points.detail: Emissions, energy, water, waste, workforce and governance data may sit in the BRSR, the annual report and a sustainability report, with different values in each.

pain_points.title: Mixed units and restatements
pain_points.detail: Energy in gigajoules or megawatt hours, emissions with or without intensity ratios and restated prior-year figures make comparison slow.

pain_points.title: Gaps are hard to see
pain_points.detail: A missing leadership indicator or a KPI without assurance is easy to overlook when analysts are keying long lists of fields.

pain_points.title: Private portfolio data is messier still
pain_points.detail: Unlisted portfolio companies send ESG questionnaires and spreadsheets in their own formats.

solution.overview: We build an ESG extraction pipeline that takes BRSR filings, using the structured XBRL version where it is filed and the PDF otherwise, along with annual and sustainability reports. It locates each indicator by principle and section, extracts reported values with units and reporting boundary, and normalises them to your chosen units. Intensity ratios are recalculated from reported inputs and compared with what the company states. Year-on-year changes, restatements, missing disclosures and assurance status for BRSR Core KPIs are flagged. Every value carries a citation and a label separating reported figures from derived ones. Analysts review anomalies before data reaches your scoring model.
capabilities: Reads BRSR XBRL filings where available and PDF reports otherwise, including annual and sustainability reports
Extracts essential and leadership indicators across the nine principles, plus BRSR Core KPIs
Normalises units and recalculates intensity ratios from reported inputs
Flags year-on-year anomalies, restatements, missing disclosures and assurance status
Labels every value as reported or derived, with a citation to the page or XBRL tag
Maps indicators to your scoring template and, where requested, to GRI or ISSB fields

workflow.title: Collect filings and reports
workflow.detail: BRSR filings, annual reports, sustainability reports and assurance statements are gathered per company and year.

workflow.title: Locate and extract indicators
workflow.detail: Indicators are found by principle and section and extracted with units, boundary and citation.

workflow.title: Normalise and recalculate
workflow.detail: Units are standardised and intensity ratios recomputed from reported inputs.

workflow.title: Check consistency
workflow.detail: Values are compared across documents and years, and gaps and assurance status are flagged.

workflow.title: Analyst review
workflow.detail: Anomalies and low-confidence values go to an ESG analyst for confirmation.

workflow.title: Load to your ESG database
workflow.detail: Reviewed data is exported to your ESG database, scoring model or data warehouse.

compliance_notes: SEBI requires the largest listed companies to publish BRSR, with independent assurance or assessment of BRSR Core KPIs being phased in; the pipeline extracts what is reported and flags what is missing.
Extraction supports, but does not replace, your ESG methodology or the work of assurance providers and ESG rating providers.

faqs.q: Why not just use the XBRL filings?
faqs.a: Where XBRL is available and complete, we use it first. Analysts also need context from PDFs, such as boundaries, notes and restatements, and data from annual and sustainability reports that XBRL does not cover.

faqs.q: Can it map to GRI, ISSB or CSRD frameworks?
faqs.a: Yes, as a mapping layer on top of the extracted indicators, for global investors who need it. The mapping is reviewed with your team because definitions do not always line up exactly.

faqs.q: Does it handle Scope 3 and value chain disclosures?
faqs.a: It extracts whatever the company reports, including Scope 3 and value chain data where disclosed, and labels the stated boundary and method. It does not estimate missing Scope 3 figures.
It can apply your scoring formula to reviewed data, but it does not invent a methodology. Scores remain your team's responsibility.
